vetSays.line: 🛡️ Enzo, Judith, Kevin and Santiago met them at the door — 4 put down. Enzo, Judith, Kevin, Santiago are hurt.
🛡️ Enzo, Jerome, Judith, Kevin and Ruby met them at the door — 5 put down. Enzo, Jerome, Judith, Ruby are hurt.
✨ Ability gained: Cold-Blooded (L1). You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Judith just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Enzo just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Enzo, Jerome, Kevin, Victor and Ruby met them at the door — 5 put down. Enzo, Jerome, Kevin, Victor, Ruby are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kevin just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Enzo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pavel just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kevin just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
🛡️ Enzo, Kevin, Santiago, Victor and Pavel met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Enzo, Kevin, Santiago, Victor, Pavel are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chantal just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Chantal met them at the door — 1 put down. Chantal is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The RERUN ×2 Scarred The Audit is still frozen from your scream.
You don't stroll through the RERUN ×2 Scarred The Audit.
